verdict.rationale: Trello's own materials claim it can "automate tasks and workflows" (trello-docs-3), which is a first-party automation capability. However, nothing in the evidence shows schedule-based or recurring-event triggers. Webhooks and Power-Up buttons are developer building blocks or manual triggers, not scheduled workflows, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented scheduled/time-based triggers, recurring-event rule configuration, details of what automated actions can do for routine team work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
